title: A docs-only lane diff is not refused by the test-first arm
body: Evidence and root cause: .krn/runs/audit/system-audit.md, row D3.
Outcome: testFirstRefusal skips a diff with no source change, so a docs/chore lane ships instead of ending BLOCKER 73 after a paid session.
Proof: a stop-hook unit test with a docs-only diff yields no refusal; a src change without a test still refuses.
